title: Live: College Football
description: The No. 5 Fighting Irish (8-1) vie for their 11th consecutive victory over the Eagles (4-5). Boston College last beat Notre Dame in 2008. Notre Dame held off then-No. 1 Miami, 31-24, last week behind CJ Carr's 319 passing yards and three TD tosses.

title: Live: College Football
description: The Boilermakers (3-6) visit the No. 15 Hawkeyes (7-2) at Kinnick Stadium. Purdue seeks to snap a three-game skid after falling to Maryland, 34-29, while Iowa handed Northwestern its third loss this season and looks for its third straight win.
